name: Akashi Ami
source:
Protagonist in [url=/c131377]Sugawa Ginnosuke[/url]'s story, Ginnosuke was the "Flower Shop Onii-san" that Ami admired several years ago. Ami works as an interior designer.
She has strong minded, hard worker to the point of workaholic, and is dedicated to anything she does; though she is clumsy. 
She was inspired by the work of "Flower Shop Onii-san" that she met when she just started working, and she greatly respects him.
